metadata.name: Voice Chat
metadata.description: Minimalist real-time voice conversation space with local STT model reuse, decoupled Agent backends, and streaming TTS

stage.orbAria: Voice conversation orb. Click to start, finish speaking, or interrupt playback.
stage.previewSubConnecting: Preparing local speech recognition and conversation session…
stage.previewSubListening: Hi, I'm listening. Tap the circle to preview the thinking ribbon and voice motion…

settings.title: Voice Chat Settings
settings.subtitle: Speech recognition, dialogue brain, and speech synthesis are decoupled and saved locally right away.
settings.brainModeHint: This plugin handles audio in/out while reasoning and tools run in the chosen brain
settings.agentRuntimeHint: Calls the unified Agent Service exposed by the Host app
settings.agentMemoryHint: Session mode preserves multi-turn context across utterances
settings.fillerOnToolHint: Speak a brief natural acknowledgement when an Agent tool call takes longer than 800ms
settings.externalTierHint: Uses the signed-in Host account gateway without exposing API keys
settings.customApiKeyHint: Stored only in this plugin's isolated local storage
settings.disableThinkingHint: Turns off thinking mode on models like DeepSeek V4 for instant first-token response
settings.systemPromptHint: Keeps replies concise, conversational, comma-segmented, and free of Markdown symbols
settings.sttProviderHint: Reuses the local SenseVoice model and microphone routing already on this computer
settings.sttLanguageHint: SenseVoice natively handles mixed Chinese and English speech
settings.localBridgeUrlHint: Connects to a local resident VAD + ASR service in Developer Mode, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7860
settings.localModelReuseHint: Automatically shares the local model and AI Board / system microphone preference configured in Voice Input without re-downloading models.
settings.ttsProviderHint: Supports zero-setup system voice or low-latency clause-streaming synthesis
settings.wainaoTtsModelHint: Select a real-time speech synthesis model on Wainao Gateway
settings.wainaoProjectIdHint: Project identifier required for Wainao speech synthesis gateway
settings.ttsEndpointHint: Compatible cloud endpoint or local resident Sherpa-ONNX server URL
settings.ttsModelHint: Model identifier for the selected TTS service
settings.ttsVoiceIdHint: Leave blank for the default natural voice, or enter a specific voice / clone ID
settings.ttsApiKeyHint: Stored only in this plugin's private local storage
settings.clauseStreamingHint: Synthesizes the first short clause as soon as a comma or period arrives to cut latency
settings.autoContinueHint: Automatically return to listening after AI finishes speaking
settings.bargeInHint: Tap the circle or press the shortcut while AI is speaking to stop playback and listen immediately
settings.subtitlesHint: Off by default for pure voice interaction; gently fades in the current line when enabled
settings.resetHint: Reset brain, speech recognition, speech synthesis, and visual mood to recommended defaults
